posts.title: Accelerating Ubuntu Core Desktop
posts.description: Canonical is resuming work on their modern, immutable, secure desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop. Work based on a previous demo has already been rebased on core26 , with three clearly defined initial use cases over the coming months. The project aims to become the default for a future release of Ubuntu.

posts.title: Write it yourself
posts.description: Gathering my thoughts on the use of LLMs for writing prose, and how I’ve changed my workflow following some feedback and reflection on my own writing.

posts.title: If it hurts, do it more!
posts.description: The phrase “if it hurts, do it more often” has bee applied variously to software teams and processes in the last fifteen years, and is a means to improve team processes and efficiency, but must be wielded carefully! This post covers my application of, and experience with this idea during my time leading Ubuntu Engineering and Charm Engineering at Canonical.
